mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, a strongly asymmetric cross-sectional tail in completed liquid-alt returns identifies the direction in which speculative risk is being repriced first. Follow that alt-tail direction in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the median-centered cubic alt-return tail mass
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt breadth counts signs, dispersion discards direction, tail dependence measures joint BTC-alt extremes through time, and wick consensus uses intrabar rejection geometry. HVCARTAR uses the signed asymmetry of the six-alt completed-return cross section, no BTC directional return, flow, volume, funding, OI, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed variation must be in its causal upper 35%, while the absolute alt-tail asymmetry must enter its causal upper quartile.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse offset eight-hour cross-alt tail-asymmetry onsets are absent from Gross9

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows per symbol in [D-8h,D)
features.alt_return: log(last completed close / first completed open) independently per symbol
features.cross_section_center: median of the six finite alt returns
features.centered_return: alt return minus the cross-sectional median
features.absolute_tail_mass: sum(abs(centered_return) cubed), required finite and strict positive
features.tail_asymmetry: signed_tail_mass / absolute_tail_mass, required finite and strict nonzero
features.tail_asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(tail_asymmetry) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_realized_variation: sum squared BTCUSDT one-minute log(close/open) returns over the same completed block, finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: research-supported cross-market order-flow propagation translated into a source-available, outcome-blind cross-sectional tail-leadership state

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no symbol basket, return formula, center, tail power, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
